groups.label: Steam
groups.help: Needs a Steam Web API key from the Steam developer site.

groups.label: PlayStation
groups.help: Needs the npsso token from a signed-in PlayStation web session.

groups.label: Xbox
groups.help: Uses the Home Assistant Xbox sensors; no key here. Set the entity names per player in the add-on settings.

groups.label: Destiny 2
groups.help: Needs a Bungie API key from the Bungie developer portal.
